title: Causative Verbs & Passive Reporting Structures: Have/Get Something Done & It is Alleged
objective: Menggunakan bentuk kausatif dan struktur pasif impersonal untuk pelaporan berita dan investigasi.

theory.summary: Causative verbs dan passive reporting structures adalah dua struktur penting dalam bahasa Inggris formal, khususnya untuk konteks profesional, akademis, dan jurnalistik. Causative verbs (have/get something done) digunakan ketika kita menyuruh atau meminta orang lain melakukan sesuatu untuk kita, bukan kita yang melakukannya sendiri. Passive reporting structures (It is said that.../She is believed to...) digunakan untuk melaporkan informasi tanpa menyebutkan sumber secara spesifik, sangat umum dalam berita, laporan investigasi, dan tulisan akademis. Kedua struktur ini memberikan kesan profesional dan objektif dalam komunikasi.
rules: HAVE something DONE: Subject + have + object + past participle. Digunakan untuk menyatakan bahwa subjek mengatur orang lain melakukan sesuatu (lebih formal). Contoh: 'I had my car serviced yesterday.' (Saya menyuruh orang servis mobil saya kemarin.)

GET something DONE: Subject + get + object + past participle. Sama dengan 'have' tetapi lebih informal dan sering menyiratkan usaha atau kesulitan. Contoh: 'We finally got the report finished.' (Kami akhirnya berhasil menyelesaikan laporan tersebut.)

IMPERSONAL PASSIVE dengan IT: It + is/was + past participle + that-clause. Contoh: 'It is believed that the company will merge.' / 'It is alleged that he took bribes.' Digunakan untuk melaporkan opini, klaim, atau tuduhan tanpa menyebutkan sumber.

IMPERSONAL PASSIVE dengan SUBJECT: Subject + is/was + past participle + to-infinitive. Contoh: 'The minister is reported to have resigned.' / 'She is thought to be the best candidate.' Struktur ini lebih formal dan sering digunakan dalam berita.

VERB PATTERNS untuk reporting: Gunakan reporting verbs seperti say, believe, think, allege, report, claim, consider, know, expect, understand. Contoh: 'It is said that...' / 'He is considered to be...' / 'The proposal is understood to have been rejected.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Mencampurkan Active dan Passive dalam Causative
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar B2 keliru menggunakan bentuk active verb setelah have/get dalam struktur kausatif, atau lupa menggunakan past participle. Ingat bahwa dalam causative, kita tidak melakukan aksi tersebut sendiri, maka objek diikuti past participle (bentuk pasif).
commonTrap.wrong: I had my assistant to prepare the documents. / She got her hair cutting yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: I had my assistant prepare the documents. / I had the documents prepared by my assistant. / She got her hair cut yesterday.

vocab.collocation: It is alleged that the politician accepted illegal donations from corporate lobbyists.
The building is undergoing major renovations and will reopen next month.
The government commissioned an independent report on climate change impacts.
I have my car serviced every six months to maintain its warranty.
All electrical installations must be inspected by a certified engineer before use.
The CEO is purported to have known about the fraud but took no action.
We're getting the office refurbished by a local contractor next week.
They had their entire kitchen renovated to increase the property value.
Serious allegations of misconduct have been made against several board members.
The damage to the property was assessed by an independent surveyor.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Mark sedang membahas persiapan untuk audit perusahaan yang akan datang dan beberapa berita terbaru tentang industri mereka di kantor.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Mark, have you had all the financial records reviewed before the audit next week?
lines.translation: Mark, apakah kamu sudah menyuruh semua catatan keuangan diperiksa sebelum audit minggu depan?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yes, I had them checked by our internal team yesterday. Everything seems to be in order, but I'm getting the final report prepared by Friday.
lines.translation: Ya, saya sudah menyuruh tim internal memeriksa kemarin. Semuanya tampaknya sudah beres, tapi saya akan menyelesaikan laporan akhir sebelum Jumat.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good. Did you hear about TechCorp? It is alleged that their CEO has been involved in insider trading. The news broke this morning.
lines.translation: Bagus. Apakah kamu dengar tentang TechCorp? Dikabarkan bahwa CEO mereka terlibat dalam perdagangan orang dalam. Beritanya keluar pagi ini.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yes, I saw that. He is reported to have sold millions in shares just before the company announced poor quarterly results. It's quite a scandal.
lines.translation: Ya, saya lihat itu. Dia dilaporkan telah menjual saham jutaan sebelum perusahaan mengumumkan hasil kuartalan yang buruk. Ini cukup skandal.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: It is believed that the investigation will take months. This reminds me—we should get our compliance procedures updated immediately.
lines.translation: Dipercaya bahwa investigasi akan memakan waktu berbulan-bulan. Ini mengingatkan saya—kita harus segera memperbarui prosedur kepatuhan kita.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Absolutely. I'll have our legal team draft new guidelines and get them approved by the board by the end of this month.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Saya akan menyuruh tim legal kami membuat pedoman baru dan mendapatkan persetujuan dewan pada akhir bulan ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang project manager yang sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul (AI Tutor yang berperan sebagai consultant) tentang persiapan proyek besar. Gunakan causative structures dan passive reporting untuk menjelaskan apa yang sudah dan akan dilakukan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning! I understand you're managing the new infrastructure project. Can you tell me what preparations have been completed so far?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning! Yes, we've made good progress. I've had the site surveyed by engineers, and we got all the permits approved last week.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent. What about the environmental impact assessment? I heard there were some concerns raised by local residents.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It is reported that some residents have concerns, but we had the environmental study conducted by an independent firm. Their findings show minimal impact.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's reassuring. Have you arranged for the equipment and materials to be delivered? When will construction actually begin?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm getting all the heavy equipment delivered next Monday. We're having the construction team briefed on safety protocols this week, and work is expected to start by the 15th.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Sounds well organized. What about quality control? How will you ensure standards are maintained throughout the project?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We'll have inspections carried out weekly by certified inspectors. It is understood that quality cannot be compromised, so we've built in multiple checkpoints at every phase.

quiz.question: The company ___ all its computers upgraded to the latest operating system last month.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'had' dalam struktur causative 'have something done'. Kalimat ini menjelaskan bahwa perusahaan menyuruh orang lain meng-upgrade komputer (bukan melakukannya sendiri). Bentuk past simple 'had' digunakan karena ada penanda waktu 'last month'.

quiz.question: It ___ that the merger will be completed by the end of the fiscal year.
quiz.explanation: Dalam impersonal passive reporting structure dengan 'It', kita menggunakan 'is + past participle'. 'It is expected that...' adalah pola standar untuk melaporkan ekspektasi atau prediksi tanpa menyebutkan sumber spesifik. Ini sangat umum dalam konteks bisnis dan berita.

quiz.question: The minister is reported ___ secret meetings with foreign diplomats last year.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'is reported', gunakan 'to + infinitive'. Karena aksi terjadi di masa lalu (last year) dan sebelum waktu pelaporan, gunakan perfect infinitive 'to have held'. Struktur ini (Subject + is reported + to have done) menunjukkan aksi lampau yang dilaporkan sekarang.

quiz.question: We need to get the contract ___ by a lawyer before we sign it.
quiz.explanation: Dalam causative 'get something done', objek (the contract) diikuti oleh past participle (reviewed). Ini menunjukkan bahwa kita akan menyuruh atau mengatur lawyer untuk mereview kontrak, bukan kita yang mereview sendiri. Past participle menunjukkan bahwa kontrak akan 'diterima' aksi tersebut (pasif).

quiz.question: The CEO ___ to be considering resignation following the allegations of financial misconduct.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan passive form 'is believed' dalam struktur pelaporan impersonal. Pola 'Subject + is believed + to be doing' menunjukkan bahwa orang-orang percaya CEO sedang mempertimbangkan pengunduran diri saat ini. 'To be considering' (continuous infinitive) menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung.
